name: glyph-matrix

frames.best_why: The whole glyph grid is evenly lit with the bottom fade visible and nothing over it.

tagline: A faint grid of tiny symbols flickers and mutates across a dark field.
summary: A canvas background tiles small characters in an even grid. Random cells swap glyphs and settle at different opacities on a timer, giving a quiet static-like texture with an optional fade toward the bottom.
appearance: A full-bleed near-black canvas covered edge to edge in a tight, even grid of tiny pale symbols. Their brightness varies slightly, and the bottom third fades into darkness.
behaviour: On a short timer a few percent of cells choose a new character and opacity, so the field shimmers without any large movement. It sizes to its container and stops when unmounted.
demo_content: Monospace glyphs 0 1 · • + * / \ < > = on a dark page.
use_when: A developer or tech page wants a quiet code-like texture behind its content.
avoid_when: You need a calm plain surface; the dense mutating grid can distract and reduce contrast.
customise: Set glyphs, cellSize, mutationRate, interval, fadeBottom and color; canvas props such as className and style pass through.
weight_why: Canvas redraws thousands of glyphs every 90ms, skipping frames in between.

a11y.note: The canvas is aria-hidden and decorative, but the continuous mutation ignores reduced-motion.

issues: The dense grid is very low contrast, reading as texture rather than characters.
The mutation loop never pauses and ignores reduced-motion.
polish_why: Even, low-key texture that stays out of the way; very low contrast and no motion guard.
